messages.subject: textInput next to checkboxGroupInput
parts:
Hello Shiners,

I am trying to accomplish the following (as seen in the image below). I would like to make my textbox appear next to each checkbox.

This is the code I am using now -

shinyUI(
  navbarPage("RShiny App",
             tabPanel("Text + Checkbox",
  titlePanel("How do I Make my textbox appear next to each checkbox?"),
            fluidRow(
              column(width = 3,
                     wellPanel(
                       selectInput("dataset", "Choose a dataset:", 
                                   choices = c("Distribution 1", "Distribution2", "Cost1")),
                       numericInput("obs", "Number of observations to view:", 10)
                     ),
                     br(),
                     br(),
                     br(),
                     br(),
                     img(src ="Rshiny.png", height = 225, width = 300)),
             column(9,
                    checkboxGroupInput("Threshold", 
                                       label = h3("Choose Threshold Criteria"), 
                                       choices = Choice_Threshold,
                                       selected = 1),
                    textInput("text", label = h3("Enter Threshold Values here"), 
                              value = Signal_Thresholds[1,4])
             )

           )

)

)
)
Any suggestions, please? Thanks so much in advance.

messages.author: e6d426c9552b1af9
messages.subject: Re: textInput next to checkboxGroupInput
parts:
Hi,

one way is to use renderUI like this:

runApp(list(
  ui = fluidPage(
   
    fluidRow(
      column(3,
             uiOutput("RenderSliders")
      )
    )
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
   
    output$RenderSliders <- renderUI({
     
      Animals     <- c("cat","dog","fish","cow")
      NrOfAnimals <- length(Animals)
     
      L <- vector("list",length = NrOfAnimals)
     
      for(i in 1:NrOfAnimals){
       
        L[[i]]  <- fluidRow(column(1,checkboxInput(paste0("x",i) ,NULL,TRUE)),
                            column(2,Animals[i]),
                            column(4,numericInput(paste0("y",i) , NULL, value = i, min = 0, max = 10, step = 1)))
      }
     
      return(L)
     
    })
   
  }
))


best Herman
